_comment: THE DELIVERY BOARD (runner_board, delivery_board:true) is a SEPARATE mechanical prop, browse-only (WIGame._interact_delivery_board), distinct from THE REQUEST BOARD's own board:true flag so interact()'s prop dispatch routes to the right one.
interior_flavor: Nothing there. Blank slips under a stone weight, and a block of rope wax with a thumb-groove worn into it.
Nothing there. A pair of spare boots by the door, laces slack through every eyelet.

floor_layers._pick: #225 floor differentiation: the Runner's Guild reads as a patterned herringbone wood hall, distinct from the inn's straight tavern planks. Reuses the inn's OWN verified bedroom-corner herringbone swatch (Interior_Walls_01 [16,21]/[17,21], rgb~97,76,38) -- same sheet/family, no new license, footstep-wood stays honest.

entities._comment: talk_pool fires her 'First approach' bark (board-copy.md sec.3) before the real conversation graph (vess_counter.json) on the first talk of a waking.
entities.observe: A teenage Drake, wiry, a strap-scarred satchel worn even behind the counter — she never fully sat down, she just stopped moving for a second. Slate-grey scales, a sweat-band she does not need indoors and wears anyway.
talk_pool: Runner's Guild! Board's live. Take a slip, show me, go. It's yours until it's theirs — sleep on a run, you carry the shame instead.

entities._comment: browse-only (WIGame._interact_delivery_board), the delivery-loop's twin of THE REQUEST BOARD (guild_board), same header/second_visit/footer shape, distinct delivery_board:true flag so interact()'s prop dispatch routes to the right board.
entities.toast: THE DELIVERY BOARD, painted across the top rail. Slips hang under it by destination: gold by distance, paid on the mark, same-waking terms. Take one and the counter logs it.
entities.second_visit_toast: THE DELIVERY BOARD. Your slip's still logged at the counter.
entities.observe: A line chalked on the rail under the board: start with the market run. The slips above it pay more and go further.
A Gnoll runner, propped against the wall by the stool, legs out, boots still laced. Not asleep. Not far from it.
talk_pool: Floodplains double, both legs mud. Wake me for a fire or a Courier.

entities._comment: #348 slice 2 `hearth` carrier. state_counter names the counter the state_set row banks; visual_states must watch that same id or the one-way set is invisible (data_lint enforces the pair).
entities.observe: A wide stone hearth, swept back to the brick, with split kindling laid under a lattice of dry birch. Cold air comes down the flue and stirs the loose bark on top of it.
entities.kindle_toast: [Firefly] — The flame takes the birch on the second breath. Heat crawls out into the room and the stone begins giving it back.
entities.toast: Split kindling sits laid and ready under dry birch. The hearth is cold, and nobody here carries flint.

entities._comment: #348 slice 2 `unlit` carrier -- answers BOTH burns and toggles_light through the table; no authored requires_skill arm, which is the whole point (contrast inn's unlit_lantern).
entities.observe: A brass lamp bracketed to the wall over the slip rack, glass sooted at the top and dry as bone. Tip the reservoir and nothing moves in it.
entities.kindle_toast: [Firefly] — The wick takes the flame and holds it. Yellow light spreads down the wall and over the slips pinned there.
entities.light_toast: [Light] — The orb slides into the lamp glass and settles. Yellow light spreads down the wall and over the slips pinned there.
entities.toast: A wall lamp over the slip rack, glass sooted and wick dry. It has been dark long enough that the runners read by the door instead.

entities._comment: #348 slice 2 `dirty` carrier: the generalized grime cell. The inn's dirty_table keeps its AUTHORED requires_skill arm and wins by precedence -- this one carries no arm and resolves off the table alone.
entities.observe: Road mud dried in ridges across the boards, stamped there by a week of packs set down hard. One corner is scrubbed down to bare wood, and the ridges start again an inch from it.
entities.clean_toast: [Basic Cleaning] — The dried mud breaks up under the cloth and goes off the edge of the table in flakes. What is left is pale grain, dry to the touch.
entities.toast: Dried road mud ridges the boards where pack after pack has come down on them. The boards still smell of the road.
